d: Short, platinum white hair with deep blue under-layers and sharp bangs frames a youthful face with narrow, glowing crimson eyes and a black fabric mask covering the lower half of the face. The slender build is dressed in a white and grey tactical ensemble featuring a white sleeveless utility vest, black straps crossing the chest, and low-rise black bottoms with metallic buckles. Two curved, glowing pink horns emerge from the head, paired with black mechanical headset pieces over the ears.
